domain_choice: (a) expense/procurement, reframed as simplified linear ТЭЛ
domain_justification: Triage is most VIVID here: intake-agent emits instantly-graspable named buckets (category/budget_article/direction) AND computes the routing consequence «money → who must approve» (≥threshold→finance controller, ≥5M₽→legal), which makes the moat moment land. Keeps the demo a true straight-through SUBSET of the ТЭЛ acceptance benchmark (§1.4/§3) rather than a different class — ITSM (b) has a flatter triage, no native money→authority logic, and its timers/SLA (reference-tel §4) pull it out of ТЭЛ.
one_flow_or_two: ONE linear flow (two agent acts on one ТЭЛ instance). intake (S2) and legal-precheck (S3) are sequential steps on a single straight-through instance; S3's dealContext input is derived from S2's triage output (amount/kind/direction). Two demos would strip legal-precheck of its natural trigger (the threshold intake computes) and add a second instance — extra load for the same 5 minutes.
